October 19 with a broken seal, solo mining to someone else's wallet and
overclocked by someone other than you. You asked for a fresh unit instead
of keeping it, and the fault and the evidence went to the team. We agreed
you'd leave it unplugged. The $19.45 I'd questioned turned out to be
shipping, not an extra charge. The Harlo OS Diagnostics line was $0.00.

gave you a $25 code for your next order, HD-••••••, valid over $100.
Still open: the replacement RMA approval, and the ship date for the Magic

Hi John,

No, you haven't missed an email, and I'm sorry you've had to chase this. Here is exactly where things stand this morning.

The replacement for the BC04 on order Shop···· still needs a sign-off from the team before I can buy your prepaid return label and release the fresh unit. I've put it in front of them again just now, flagged with the broken seal, the overclock and the wallet, and a colleague is picking it up today. As soon as it clears I'll send you the label with the return reference, and the new BC04 goes out to you. Keep the unit you have unplugged until then.

On the 40T: the live listing today is Batch 8, 50 units, at $799 for 40 TH/s, here https://heliumdeploy.com/products/magic-miner-40t . I asked for Batch 8's ship date rather than repeat the November 14 I gave you for an earlier batch, and that answer is coming back to me today too, so give me a few hours before you place it and you'll be buying on a date I've confirmed. Your $25 code HD-•••••• still works on it, over $100.

I'll write again the moment either answer lands.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy

Looks like I’m up and running now, sorry for the fire drill

I’m debating ordering a 40T, any chance one will ship sooner than December?

Sent from my iPhone

Hi John,

Glad to hear it is hashing, and no apology needed. That seal was worth asking about.

On the 40T, the only batch open on the site right now is Batch 8 at $799, and I cannot get one out ahead of it. The batches ship strictly in order, oldest orders first, so a unit bought today goes out with Batch 8 on the date the team gave you. I am not going to pull a date forward to make the sale. If anything moves earlier when stock lands, I will tell you.

If you want hashrate running before then, the units on the shelf today are the smaller ones, the Hammer Thor P2 at $379 for 10 TH/s and the Bitfortun BS-4 at $599.99 for 18 TH/s. Honestly though, at $19.98 per terahash the 40T is the best value we sell, which is why people wait for it. Your $25 code HD-•••••• still works on it, over $100.

You can follow incoming batches here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

If you were happy with how this got sorted, a word on Trustpilot would mean a lot: https://www.trustpilot.com/review/heliumdeploy.com . And you are welcome in our Discord for new drops and help: https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf

Sarah, HeliumDeploy
